title: Welcome to the DIY Hydro Fieldwork course pages [Under construction]
text:
This site introduces hands-on hydrology experiments designed for field-based learning, developed by the Hydro Group of the University of Bern.
Developers: Ueli Ammann, University of Bern, ueli.ammann unibe.ch Bettina Schaefli, University of Bern, bettina.schaefli unibe.ch Natalie Ceperley, University of Bern, natalie ceperley unibe.ch
Use the navigation pane to explore each experiment.
Please report any questions/bugs.


The development of the course, the pilot and test phase is funded through the Impuls Lehre programme (2026–2028) of the University of Bern.
